'''Souphog''' is a [[Fire]] type [[Healer]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves into [[Grillhog]] at 6 bronze stars.

==Overview==
Current Description: "Listen. The food is part of the outfit, alright? There are tons of unique styles out there, no need to make a fuss."

Souphog is a purple rarity Tatari.

==Appearance==
A small pig sitting in a bowl with just its head visible. It is balancing a red chili pepper and has a tear in its eye. Its bowl is dark maroon, yellow, and with a red flame pattern.

Souphog's [[Tatari#Glitter Tataris|Glitter]] variant changes the yellow and red on its bowl to blue instead.

== Evolution Trial ==
Souphog's evolution trial unlocks once it reaches 6 bronze stars/19 copies. To evolve it into [[Grillhog]] you need to complete the following task:
* Feed Souphog Lava Ramen x1, Spicy Soda x1, and Cookie x1

== Trivia ==
* Original Bio: "When your Souphog gets hurt, don't be surprised when it yells, 'No soup for you!'"
* Prior to the update on 3/11/2026, its bio description said: "When your Souphog gets hurt, don't be shocked when you get no soup."
* Prior to the update on 5/12/2026, its bio description said: "Accidentally fell into a bowl of spicy soup, and now Souphog's eyes can't stop watering."
